svg.title: C28 / LOWELL LUNAR LANTERN engineering mission profile
svg.desc: C28, LOWELL LUNAR LANTERN. Original project: Narrow-band Filter Photometry Calibration for the Lowell 20''. Session C: Astronomy & Space Physics. Scientific question: What calibration model yields reproducible narrowband fluxes across airmass, source color, seeing, detector position, and observing night for the verified Lowell system? Testable hypothesis: Measured throughput and spectrophotometric standards will reduce color-dependent residuals relative to a zero-point-only calibration, especially near sharp spectral features and filter band edges.. svg.text: Narrow-band Filter Photometry Calibration for the Lowell 20''
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Create a traceable narrowband photometric calibration for the telescope
named in the original title, pending verification of its actual camera,
filters, and observing setup. Measure total-system throughput, atmospheric
extinction, detector response, and aperture corrections. Use
spectrophotometric standards to produce synthetic band-integrated fluxes
rather than assume a broadband color transformation applies to narrowband
What calibration model yields reproducible narrowband fluxes across airmass,
source color, seeing, detector position, and observing night for the
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
Measured throughput and spectrophotometric standards will reduce
color-dependent residuals relative to a zero-point-only calibration,
especially near sharp spectral features and filter band edges.
Verify telescope identity and equipment documentation; no original Lowell
Standards must span relevant spectral colors and airmass; use current
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
Narrow filters can be sensitive to stellar lines, telluric absorption, and
redshift. Imperfect flats or atmospheric variability can dominate precision;
synthetic calibration is only as accurate as throughput and reference
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
TRACEABILITY / IDs THAT STAY WITH THE WORK
Execution evidence is required before case closure.

A question becomes a model. A model earns evidence.
